author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Bambu Lab's newest flagship multi-material 3D printer has arrived. We review the Bambu H3C after testing it for the past month and explain the new Swaptek print tool system and how it differs from other tool changer FDM printers. Here are the three most unique features of the H3C: a massive new integrated AMS, easy TPU printing, and finally, multi-diameter nozzle support. Here's how each performs. 

Bambu Lab H3C: https://us.store.bambulab.com/products/h3c
Disclosure: This product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review and is not sponsored. 
Update: Bambu just announced accessory pricing: $100 Print Tools, $35 hotends

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
